post.summary: Execute a role-authorized domain action atomically
post.description: Requires same-origin Origin header and trusted platform identity. register/switch selects synthetic account via HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict cookie. No outbound messages. salaryTo must be >= salaryFrom. Terminal invitation states cannot be changed. Unverified accounts only verify/switch. Server ignores client-supplied grade/score in profile. Test duration 30 minutes, 12 questions / 4 competencies (2 mandatory applied traces and 1 knowledge question per competency; choice order randomized), 10 starts/hour, overall score >=75 and >=2/3 correct in every competency, 90-day successful grade change cooldown.

post.summary: Run a role-bound action in the normalized account store
post.description: Disabled by default. Requires trusted platform principal and same-origin Origin. Registration requires current privacy consent; replay preserves account role/email and reuses the newest existing challenge. Register, email-request and email-retry await at most one own-account, server-selected dispatch with a ten-second transport timeout. Retry reuses the exact payload/key and honors backoff/leases/five attempts. No public/global drain or automatic background retry exists. Provider sending requires separately approved configuration. For profile/company, client contact is ignored and the verified account email is used.

get.description: Separate synthetic guest table; never accesses personal workspace or real-account data. Short-lived server-generated token in HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Strict host-only cookie; no token or owner accepted in URL. Requests expire after two hours; 120 requests/minute per session, 32 new sessions/minute globally, 128 active sessions, 256KiB state. POST requires matching Origin and application/json. Contact and role rules are unchanged. Reset requires action=reset-demo and confirm=true.

choices.description: Optional public answer options in randomized display order. Submit the selected string. Contains no answer-key marker.

caseSensitive.description: When true, the exact case-sensitive identifier must be entered. This is a format hint, not an answer.

contact.description: Included only for the accepting candidate’s specific employer while candidate consent remains active.

skillGroups.description: Recognized simple two-skill OR groups. Any one confirmed skill satisfies the group.

candidateContact.description: Absent until acceptance, and absent after consent withdrawal.
